Topics · Death and what comes after

Do those who escape justice ever answer for it?

God saw what happened. A justice that loses no right or atom of good, and a mercy that cancels nothing owed.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَـٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And never think that Allāh is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them [i.e., their account] for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].

Quran · Ibrahim 14:42

Translation

Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil. Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him. But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.

Original · Hebrew

אֲשֶׁר֙ אֵין־נַעֲשָׂ֣ה פִתְגָ֔ם מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ה מְהֵרָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֡ן מָלֵ֞א לֵ֧ב בְּֽנֵי־הָאָדָ֛ם בָּהֶ֖ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָֽע׃ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֹטֶ֗א עֹשֶׂ֥ה רָ֛ע מְאַ֖ת וּמַאֲרִ֣יךְ ל֑וֹ כִּ֚י גַּם־יוֹדֵ֣עַ אָ֔נִי אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה־טּוֹב֙ לְיִרְאֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽירְא֖וּ מִלְּפָנָֽיו׃ וְטוֹב֙ לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה לָֽרָשָׁ֔ע וְלֹֽא־יַאֲרִ֥יךְ יָמִ֖ים כַּצֵּ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֵינֶ֥נּוּ יָרֵ֖א מִלִּפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

Ecclesiastes · 8:11-13

World English Bible

Your question belongs here. Much injustice has never been answered in this world. The killer dies in his bed, and people forget the victim. If that were the end of the story, justice would be a dream with no footing. The verse speaks to the one who waits and sees nothing: do not think God is unaware. Delay is not forgetting, and silence is not approval.

A question for you

What hurts most in this question?

If you sayThat the unjust person thrives.
ThenThat is the heart of this question, and the next part sets it on one scale.
If you sayThat the victim is forgotten.
ThenThe last part is about this: nothing of those who endured, or of what they carried, is lost.
If you sayThat God allows this.
ThenThat is a great and honourable question, and it has its own Step.

Part 2 of 3

﴿أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَوَآءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ٢١ وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ٢٢﴾

Translation of the meaning

Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death?[1472] Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume]. And Allāh created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

Translator's notes

[1472] Another meaning is "...[the evildoers being] equal in their life and their death," i.e., unresponsive to guidance.

Quran · Al-Jathiyah 45:21-22

Translation

Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.

Original · Hebrew

וְשַׁבְתֶּם֙ וּרְאִיתֶ֔ם בֵּ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק לְרָשָׁ֑ע בֵּ֚ין עֹבֵ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוֹ׃

Malachi · 3:18

World English Bible

﴿قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins.[1354] Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

Translator's notes

[1354] For those who repent and correct themselves.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:53

Translation

Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

Original · Hebrew

יַעֲזֹ֤ב רָשָׁע֙ דַּרְכּ֔וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אָ֖וֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֑יו וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אֶל־יְהוָה֙ וִֽירַחֲמֵ֔הוּ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כִּֽי־יַרְבֶּ֥ה לִסְלֽוֹחַ׃

Isaiah · 55:7

World English Bible

The verse puts a question your conscience cannot ignore: are those who harm and those who do good alike, in life and in death? If death is the end for all, the answer is yes, and killer and victim come to the same thing. The next verse says the heavens and earth were made in truth, so that each soul is repaid for what it earned, with no injustice. Justice is no addition to the world; it is among the reasons for it.

A question for you

If everything ended at death, would the killer and the victim be alike?

If you sayYes, and I cannot bear that.
ThenThen your conscience is asking what the verse asks. Accepting or refusing that is yours.
If you sayYes, the world is simply unfair.
ThenAn honest position, and one that takes the pain seriously. The verse only asks where you got the measure of fairness you are judging by.
If you sayNo, the difference stands in itself.
ThenThen you keep the moral difference. The question left is whether a difference never answered amounts to justice.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ٧ وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ٨﴾

Translation of the meaning

So whoever does an atom's weight[1965] of good will see it, And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

Translator's notes

[1965] Or "the weight of a small ant."

Quran · Az-Zalzalah 99:7-8

Translation

For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

כִּ֤י אֶת־כָּל־מַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים יָבִ֥א בְמִשְׁפָּ֖ט עַ֣ל כָּל־נֶעְלָ֑ם אִם־ט֖וֹב וְאִם־רָֽע׃

Ecclesiastes · 12:14

World English Bible

﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ ۖ وَإِن تَكُ حَسَنَةً يُضَـٰعِفْهَا وَيُؤْتِ مِن لَّدُنْهُ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, Allāh does not do injustice, [even] as much as an atom's weight; while if there is a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:40

Translation

Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

Original · Hebrew

מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי־אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃

Job · 36:23

World English Bible

If the accounting is exact to an atom's weight, what happened is not lost, in either direction. Not what was stolen, not the patience in bearing it, not the true word a weak person spoke. What matters most here is the side that concerns the wounded: every good you did, all your patience, is kept. These verses are less about what will befall anyone than about nothing being lost. Mercy and what is owed both remain, and how they meet in each case we do not fully know.

A question for you

What do you need to know is kept?

If you sayThe right of the one who was harmed.
ThenThe verses say nothing is lost. The harder questions about justice in the next life have their own Step.
If you sayMy own patience.
ThenThe verses reach that: an atom's weight, including what no one knows of you.
If you sayThat the one who harmed me turns back.
ThenThat is a great hope, and the Quran leaves a door for it (25:70).
